foot.not_advice: It is not medical advice. It cannot diagnose, and nothing here should change a test, treatment or isolation decision without your own clinician or TB programme. TB is a notifiable disease. Criteria, regimens, doses and guideline statements are quoted as published. Please check the original sources, which are listed in full in the Sources module.
shell.disclaimer: The TB Companion is an educational synthesis of published literature for study and for patient and family understanding. It does not replace a doctor, nurse or TB programme. Regimens, doses, test cut-offs and guideline statements are reported as published, not as instructions or a diagnosis for any individual. TB is a notifiable disease, and treatment is effective and free in most public programmes; anyone with symptoms such as a lasting cough should see a clinician.
shell.note: An animated, cited guide to tuberculosis for students, people with TB and their families. Educational only, not medical advice. Your place is saved on this device.
